title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, July 20, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, July 20, 2018 Posted by admin on July 20th, Disney (DIS). down -125 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -134.79 (-0.53%) at 25,064.50.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.40%.
There were 8 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by IBM (IBM) +3.27% and Disney (DIS) +1.30%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Travelers (TRV) -3.71% and American Express (AXP) -2.73%.
Microsoft (MSFT -0.68%) is up more than 3% in premarket trading after it reported Q4 revenue of $30.09 billion, better than consensus of $29.22 billion.
General Electric (GE -0.15%) climbed nearly 3% in premarket trading after it reported Q2 revenue of $30.1 billion, higher than consensus of $29.38 billion.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
